Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. As Principal, Marketing Measurement, you'll lead the evolution of how HubSpot measures and optimizes its marketing measurement and investments — building the measurement infrastructure and decision-making framework that enables confident capital allocation decisions across organic, paid, owned, and earned channels.
HubSpot operates a significant and growing marketing presence across organic channels, paid media, a robust content and media network, and earned and owned activations. As we scale through brand-led, multi-channel demand creation, we're building the capability to understand what drives incremental growth across all marketing levers and translate those insights into smarter investment decisions. This role leads that work, working closely with cross functional teams across Marketing, Finance, Data Science, Engineering, and Product — combining marketing mix modeling, incrementality testing, multi-touch and modernized attribution, and predictive forecasting into a unified measurement capability that serves Marketing and Finance alike.
This is a high-visibility role for someone who combines deep measurement expertise with the strategic instincts to connect analytical rigor to the decisions that matter most.
What You'll Do
Measurement Strategy & Attribution
Deep understanding of full funnel Marketing strategy and techniques.
Own and evolve the marketing measurement framework across organic, paid, owned, Brand, LLM/AEO, media/creators, and earned channels — establishing a single, consistent view of how marketing investment drives revenue.
Own and develop how marketing tracks full funnel attribution across the buyer journey across all channels and touchpoints.
Modernize attribution methodology — moving beyond last-click toward view-based, multi-touch, and buying-group-aware models that capture the full influence of marketing activity on the path to revenue.
Develop executive-ready reporting and performance narratives that connect marketing investment to revenue outcomes, enabling capital allocation decisions with confidence.
Marketing Mix Modeling & Incrementality
Build and operate Marketing Mix Models that quantify the marginal ROI of investment across channels — enabling evidence-based scenario planning and capital allocation between paid, owned, and earned.
Establish and scale an incrementality testing program — designing holdout methodology, running causal experiments, and translating results into investment recommendations.
Partner with Marketing and Finance leadership to move budget conversations from channel-by-channel negotiation toward joint, evidence-based investment planning.
Predictive Analytics & Forecasting
Build and operationalize predictive LTV models that connect upstream marketing signals to downstream revenue outcomes — enabling spend decisions grounded in expected long-term customer value.
Develop multi-horizon revenue forecasting capabilities that translate real-time marketing indicators into expected ARR outcomes, giving Marketing and Finance a continuously updated view of performance.
Drive the build vs. buy roadmap for predictive tooling — evaluating vendor solutions, managing external partnerships, and defining where proprietary models create lasting advantage.
Data Science Leadership
Lead and direct data science execution toward measurement priorities — maintaining the technical depth to design experiments, validate methodology, and hold quality bar on outputs.
Advance AI and machine learning applications across measurement, attribution, targeting, and forecasting to improve the speed and accuracy of marketing decision-making.
What You'll Bring
Required Qualifications
10+ years in marketing analytics or marketing data science.
Deep understanding of Marketing strategy and how it’s developed and executed on to inform and build build the right measurement approach behind it.
Deep expertise in Marketing Mix Modeling and incrementality testing — hands-on experience building or operationalizing these capabilities and connecting outputs to capital allocation decisions.
Experience building predictive LTV models and multi-horizon revenue forecasting — connecting leading marketing indicators to expected downstream revenue outcomes.
Experience building or implementing multi-touch attribution models to measure impact across a B2B SaaS buyer’s journey.
Track record of building a trusted Finance partnership — developing shared measurement frameworks that drive budget decisions, not just reporting.
Strong technical fluency — able to design experiments, validate data science outputs, and direct execution teams effectively.
Experience with modern, multi-touch attribution approaches across paid, owned, and earned channels, including view-based and buying-group-level measurement.
Excellent executive communication skills — able to translate complex causal findings into clear investment recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Nice-to-Have Qualifications
Marketing measurement and leadership experience at a B2B SaaS or high-growth technology company.
Data science background
Experience with Brand and LLM/AEO/GEO measurement techniques and attribution.
Background in or close partnership with paid media strategy and bidding optimization.
Experience evaluating and managing external measurement vendors — MMM platforms, incrementality tools, or LTV providers.
Familiarity with B2B buying-group measurement across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
Key Qualities We'll Test For
Measurement depth and methodology rigor
Finance partnership and decision-making impact
Predictive analytics and forecasting capability
Strategic operating model and build vs. buy judgment
Technical fluency and data science collaboration
Executive communication and strategic storytelling
Pay & Benefits
The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

$152,200 — $243,500 USD
At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

About the Role
We are seeking an exceptional finance transformation leader to help shape the future of our Finance organization. You’ll be the product leader for Finance: deciding what we build, buy or automate and leading the team that delivers it. Reporting to the SVP Finance, you will be responsible for transforming how Finance operates at HubSpot through AI, automation, advanced analytics, technology, process redesign and new organizational models. You will set the multi-year roadmap and personally drive the highest-impact initiatives.
You will guide Finance into a new model where automation handles the transactional work, AI and analytics deliver predictive insight, and more of the team's time goes to shaping enterprise decisions. You’ll lead a ~20-person team across analytics engineering, ML engineering, program management and finance systems support, and partner closely with the core systems owners across the company.
This is a hands-on leadership role with a significant enterprise wide scope. You will lead a well-established team, influence a broad network of stakeholders, and hold the bar on SOX compliance and auditability throughout.
What You'll Do
Define the future Finance operating model. Evaluate, evolve and own a multi-year transformation roadmap that leverages technology to strengthen our processes, systems, data, and governance. Set and track key performance indicators (KPIs) that measure the success of transformation initiatives (e.g. productivity, close speed, forecast accuracy, insight quality).
Build an AI-native Finance function. Identify and scale high-value applications of AI and automation across Finance. Redesign workflows end to end rather than automating broken ones. Decide where work belongs with people, AI, or automation, and set governance and human accountability for AI-enabled processes.
Modernize transactions and workflows. Identify opportunities to simplify and automate high-volume, repetitive and transactional Finance activities impacting a variety of end-to-end processes including, but not limited to, FP&A (Financial Planning & Analysis), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Quote-to-Cash (Q2C), Record-to-Report (R2R), Treasury, Tax and Internal Audit. Keep controls strong and scalable across financial systems.
Make insight forward-looking and self-serve. Help Finance increase production of forward-looking, predictive and actionable insights. Develop scalable tools and analytical products that enable business leaders to better understand performance drivers, tradeoffs and potential outcomes. Work with Finance leaders to improve the speed and quality of enterprise decision support. Identify opportunities to make financial insights increasingly self-service and technology enabled.
Drive cross-functional delivery. Set prioritization, governance, and accountability for major initiatives. Build alignment across Finance, Engineering, FinTech, Operations, Internal Audit, and the business without relying on direct authority. Oversee cross-functional project teams, external consultants, and technology vendors.
Shape the Finance Workforce of the Future. Assess how Finance roles and capabilities will need to evolve as automation and AI change the nature of Finance work. Develop new career experiences and capabilities that prepare Finance talent for increasingly technology-enabled work. Partner with Finance leadership to build the talent strategy required to support the future Finance organization.
What You'll Bring
A track record of leading finance transformation in a scaled technology company: ERP/system change, process redesign, automation, data modernization.
Hands-on experience building and deploying AI and automation solutions in Finance.
Practical fluency in AI, automation, and data, and the judgment to turn them into business results, with the controls to match.
Technical depth to engage with Machine Learning and Analytics Engineers on what they’re building and how.
Strong working knowledge of SOX, internal controls, and public-company reporting. Experience at a public company is not a must have but we expect a strong working knowledge of SOX, internal controls, and public-company reporting processes.
Proven ability to lead through influence across Finance, Engineering, and Data.
Strong analytical, executive communication, and change-leadership skills.
Comfort moving between strategy and hands-on execution.
Bachelor's degree required; MBA and/or CPA preferred.
The ideal candidate is:
A transformation leader, willing to challenge longstanding assumptions about how Finance should operate.
A strong strategic thinker, able to connect financial insights with business strategy and enterprise decision-making.
AI-forward and technology fluent, with a practical understanding of how emerging technology can fundamentally reshape Finance.
A hands-on executive, willing to personally examine processes, data and technology rather than delegating transformation.
An influential and collaborative change leader, capable of creating alignment across senior leaders and functions without direct authority.
Data-driven and intellectually curious, using evidence to challenge assumptions and continuously exploring better ways of working.
Enterprise-oriented, focused on improving outcomes for the company rather than protecting traditional functional boundaries.
